<div class="home-intro">

# Chuandong Xie

**Research Fellow in Structural Engineering, University of Aberdeen**

</div>

::: {.home-content}

I am a structural engineering researcher working at the intersection of resilient structural systems, metal additive manufacturing, structural optimisation, computational mechanics, and data-driven engineering.

I obtained my PhD in Structural Engineering from Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology in 2024. 

My research integrates large-scale experimental testing, finite element analysis, nonlinear dynamics, machine learning and explainable AI to understand structural behaviour and develop resilience-oriented engineering solutions. 

I have experience in post-event structural investigation, scientific programming and industry-engaged engineering, alongside university teaching, supervision and interdisciplinary research collaboration.




## Research interests

- Resilient and self-centring structural systems
- Performance-based seismic deisgn
- Metal additive manufacturing for structural applications
- Structural optimisation and generative design
- Computational mechanics and finite element modelling
- Machine learning and explainable AI for engineering

:::
